messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT triggered: embeddings-service error_rate > 4% (5m) in us-east-1. Pager: @oncall-engineering. Link: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/embeddings-error-rate-us-east-1
Alex Kim: seeing this too, customer reports of failed batch jobs. digging in now.
Maya Patel: I'll grab logs and check recent deploys. tagging Samir for infra check.
Samir Joshi: no deploys in the last 2h from CI. checking autoscaler and qps patterns.
Jordan Lee: dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/embeddings/latency-and-errors?orgId=1&from=now-1h to see spike. appears error spikes coincide with a retry storm at 09:12.
Alex Kim: timeline: first spike 09:10, peak 09:13, partial recovery 09:22. customers on dedicated capacity saw higher error ratios.
Priya Rao: +1 on retry storm theory. any rate-limiter logs? could be downstream kv store hiccup.
Maya Patel: grabbing service logs now: saw a flurry of 429s from downstream kvcache at 09:11-09:14, followed by 502s as our fallback path hit timeouts.
Samir Joshi: infra shows a transient network partition to kvcache cluster A in us-east-1 09:11-09:15. autoscaler spun up extra replicas but they were unhealthy until 09:18.
Alex Kim: mitigation notes: 1) throttled retries on client side via quick config change 2) toggled fallback to degraded-embedding-mode to reduce kvcache pressure 3) raised capacity in dedicated pool as temporary.
Jordan Lee: mitigation command we used:
```
kubectl patch cm embeddings-config -n prod --patch '{"data":{"client_retry_policy":"linear, max_attempts=2"}}'
```
Applied at 09:17; errors dropped after 09:19.
Maya Patel: confirm customer impact: we estimate ~12% of embedding requests failed for a 15-minute window for a subset of users on dedicated capacity. Logged SRs: #5543, #5545.
Alex Kim: good. next: paging and alerting follow-up. the alert noise here is high — network partition should not dial out to paging for <5% of traffic in one AZ. propose altering the alert to require cross-AZ error rate or longer window.
Priya Rao: agree. current alert: `sum(rate(errors[5m])) / sum(rate(requests[5m])) > 0.04` per region. we should change to `max_over_time(per_az_error_rate[10m]) > 0.04` OR require sustained cross-az elevation: `count_over_time( (per_az_error_rate > 0.04)[10m] ) >= 2`.
Samir Joshi: also recommend adding a suppression rule for known kvcache maintenance windows and a runbook annotation to indicate likely downstream causes to avoid full-page escalation.
Jordan Lee: I'll build a temp dashboard panel to show per-AZ error_rate + kvcache health side-by-side. saving here: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/embeddings/per-az-error-kvcache?orgId=1
Maya Patel: action items from triage: 1) update alert definition (Priya/Samir) 2) add annotation to runbook with diagnostic steps (Maya) 3) schedule 30m postmortem sync with SRE and Customer Success (Alex)
Alex Kim: assigning owners: Priya -> alert rule edits, Samir -> suppression and alert routing, Maya -> runbook edits and test checklist, Jordan -> dashboard. I'll own postmortem invite and customer comms draft.
Priya Rao: putting the proposed alert patch here (PromQL):
```
# require sustained, cross-az elevated errors
sum by (region) (rate(errors[10m])) / sum by (region) (rate(requests[10m])) > 0.04
and
count( distinct_over_time( per_az_error_rate > 0.04 )[10m] ) >= 2
```
Will open PR to alerting-config repo.
Samir Joshi: suppression example for alertmanager (yaml snippet):
```
route:
  group_by: [region]
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 2h
inhibit_rules:
- source_match:
    alertname: KVCacheMaintenance
  target_match:
    alertname: EmbeddingsErrorRate
  equal: [region]
```
I'll add this under ops/alerting/squelch-rules.
Maya Patel: runbook edits: adding a diagnostic checklist + quick links to kvcache runbook and fallback toggle. editing page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONCALL/embeddings-playbook -> will add section "09xx kvcache partition" with steps, runbook snippet and owner tag.
Alex Kim: please add a one-line short-hand at top of playbook: "If errors are AZ isolated, do not page unless cross-AZ or >10% request failure" — helps reduce pager storms.
Priya Rao: note: need to keep an emergency override that still pages for customers on Dedicated if SLA is affected — we'll add a label match in the alerting rule for customer_tier=dedicated to bypass suppression.
Jordan Lee: added dashboard notes and created tentative new panel. link again: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/embeddings/per-az-error-kvcache?orgId=1&panelId=4
Alex Kim: post-incident doc: I'm creating a short incident timeline + customer impact doc and will attach to the playbook. link will be posted here when ready.
Maya Patel: runbook commit done: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONCALL/embeddings-playbook?focusedEdit=1 (added section, annotated steps, flagged owner @Maya Patel).
Samir Joshi: PR opened for suppression rules: https://git.redwood.ai/ops/alerting-config/pull/812 — contains inhibitor rule and a test case.
Priya Rao: PR opened for alert rule change: https://git.redwood.ai/ops/alert-rules/pull/179 (includes unit tests for cross-az logic). please review.
Alex Kim: thanks team. follow-up meeting scheduled 1775603600 (unix ts) in #oncall-postmortem for 30m. main goals: verify alert changes, confirm runbook clarity, and finalize customer comms.
Jordan Lee: quick note for handoff: oncall for next shift @Samir Joshi — Handover: monitor the new alert PRs merge and watch dashboards for 24h.
Samir Joshi: will do. marking this thread as resolved for current paging state; will reopen if errors resurface. :white_check_mark:
